lenses.name: Ivo's plan
lenses.about: The island plan, as the planners drew it.

lenses.name: Joss's footpaths
lenses.about: The paths people actually walk, worn into the grass.

lenses.name: the low-tide chart
lenses.about: The sand bars that open when the tide is out.

edges.gone: The plan shows a footbridge here. Only its two posts are left in the water. Joss's map would have shown you.

views.text: No lens was the true map. I needed all three.
views.reply: Ivo rolls up the plan slowly. 'All three, and the one that looked most official was the one with the bridge that is not there.'

views.text: The plan is the true map. The others are additions to it.
views.reply: Joss laughs. 'The plan sent you to a bridge that fell down two winters ago. The plan is a good start. It is not the island.'

views.text: Each lens was true about something different. None was true about everything.
views.reply: Ivo and Joss look at each other. 'Then we keep all three in the harbour office,' says Ivo, 'and we write on each one what it is for.'
